name: Positive Common-Edge Prefix Width in Both Sections
parameters: For each of the two pairs $(C_0,H)$ and $(C_1,H)$ in the construction.
proof: The first section inherits the fact that the rooted factor has no zero-width order beginning with its retained edge. A conditioning of the second pair gives the rooted factor with its root prescribed first; paired-minor monotonicity transfers that positive lower bound back to the section.
